select * from `categories` where `feature_in_banner` = 1 and `categories`.`deleted_at` is null

select `products`.*, `products_categories`.`category_id` as `pivot_category_id`, `products_categories`.`product_id` as `pivot_product_id` from `products` inner join `products_categories` on `products`.`id` = `products_categories`.`product_id` where `products_categories`.`category_id` in (164, 165, 166, 185, 483, 493, 498) and `products`.`deleted_at` is null
